name: Letterboxd Watchlist Sync
description: Automatically sync your Letterboxd watchlist to a Jellyfin playlist.
overview: A scheduled background task plugin that scrapes your public Letterboxd watchlist and updates a Jellyfin playlist with matched movies by title and production year.

versions.changelog: Repackaged to exclude .deps.json and .pdb files to resolve assembly loading issues in Jellyfin.
Fix empty playlist sync bug and prevent recreate-on-sync behaviors (stable GUIDs).
Robust metadata ID matching (TMDb/IMDb), local cache, config UI dashboard stats, and Sync Now manual trigger.
Initial release of the Letterboxd Watchlist Sync plugin.

name: Letterboxd Ratings
description: Fetches average Letterboxd ratings and applies them to Jellyfin movies.
overview: A metadata provider plugin that scrapes average ratings from Letterboxd for film items in your library using TMDb/IMDb IDs, featuring local caching and request serialization.

versions.changelog: Fix ratings not applied: switch to ICustomMetadataProvider to bypass metadata merge priority (Letterboxd now always overwrites TMDb/OMDb ratings).
Repackaged to exclude .deps.json and .pdb files to resolve assembly loading issues in Jellyfin.
Build targeting net9.0 runtime to resolve NotSupported load failures, and correct checksum validation.

name: Letterboxd Watched Sync
description: Mark local movies as played based on a public Letterboxd watched list.
overview: A scheduled background task plugin that scrapes a user's public Letterboxd watched list and automatically updates their played status for matched movies in Jellyfin.

versions.changelog: Initial release of the Letterboxd Watched Sync plugin.
